notes.title: ❗ HUGE UPDATE ❗ Power-Ups, Hats and New Achievements!
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for checking out the game! 🦅[/h1] 

[h1][b]LFG![/b][/h1]

In this latest update to Super Donald World 2024, Trumpbux can be saved up and spent!

[h2][i][b]New Power-Ups include:[/b][/i][/h2]
[b]- Trumpbux Multiplier[/b]
[b]- Ghost Mode [/b](Enables you to pass through obstacles without collision)
[b]- Extra Life[/b] (Immediately refills health upon what would otherwise be death)

Hats and Appearance Items have been added!

[h2][i][b]Latest hats added:[/b][/i][/h2]
[b]- THE Classic Red Hat![/b]
[b]- Red Construction Hat![/b]
More hats will be coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39056119/4a45c2f9f19f1c41307f59ffd31526396aed3b79.png[/img]

[h1]Thanks folks! God Bless! 🦅🧱🇺🇸[/h1]
